old: The maximum number of redirects is 30.
new: The maximum number of redirects is 10.

old: Failed connections are retried 0 times by default.
new: Failed connections are retried 3 times by default.

old: Downloaded content is read in chunks of 10240 bytes.
new: Downloaded content is read in chunks of 4096 bytes.

old: Iterating over lines reads 512 bytes at a time.
new: Iterating over lines reads 1024 bytes at a time.

old: Status codes from 400 to 499 are treated as client errors.
new: Status codes from 400 to 451 are treated as client errors.

old: Port 443 is the default HTTPS port when deciding whether to keep credentials on redirect.
new: Port 8443 is also treated as a default HTTPS port when deciding whether to keep credentials on redirect.

old: Digest authentication retries the request once after a 401 response.
new: Digest authentication retries the request twice after a 401 response.

note: requests has no response cache; pass = no HIGH confidence false match
